column1: # имя | событие | ref_type | ref_name | MULTIPLE_PACKAGES | доп. окружение | ожидание

ветка main                | push | branch | main          |       | | ref_type=branch;ref_name=main;ref_name_norm=main;ref_branch=main
ветка со слешем           | push | branch | release/1.x   |       | | ref_type=branch;ref_name=release/1.x;ref_name_norm=release-1.x;ref_branch=release-1.x
ветка с двумя слешами     | push | branch | feature/a/b   |       | | ref_type=branch;ref_name=feature/a/b;ref_name_norm=feature-a-b;ref_branch=feature-a-b
ветка в multi-режиме      | push | branch | dev           | true  | | ref_type=branch;ref_name=dev;ref_name_norm=dev;ref_branch=dev
тег v1                    | push | tag    | v1            |       | | ref_type=tag;ref_name=v1;ref_name_norm=1;ref_branch=;ref_tag=v1

тег main/v1.2.3           | push | tag    | main/v1.2.3          | true | | ref_type=tag;ref_name=main/v1.2.3;ref_name_norm=main-1.2.3;ref_branch=main;ref_tag=v1.2.3;ref_tag_branch=main
тег release/1.x/v1.2.3    | push | tag    | release/1.x/v1.2.3   | true | | ref_type=tag;ref_name_norm=release-1.x-1.2.3;ref_branch=release-1.x;ref_tag=v1.2.3;ref_tag_branch=release/1.x
тег dev/v2                | push | tag    | dev/v2               | true | | ref_name_norm=dev-2;ref_tag=v2
MP в верхнем регистре     | push | tag    | main/v1.2.3   | TRUE  | | ref_name_norm=main-1.2.3
MP с пробелами и CR       | push | tag    | main/v1.2.3   |       | MULTIPLE_PACKAGES=$' True\r' | ref_name_norm=main-1.2.3
MP=yes не считается да    | push | tag    | v1.2.3        | yes   | | ref_name_norm=1.2.3
плоский тег в multi       | push | tag    | v1.2.3        | true  | | !error:must have the form
тег с веткой в single     | push | tag    | main/v1.2.3   | false | | !error:without a branch prefix
тег с веткой без MP       | push | tag    | main/v1.2.3   |       | | !error:without a branch prefix
тег без v                 | push | tag    | 1.2.3         |       | | !error:not a v-version
тег с буквами             | push | tag    | vX.Y          |       | | !error:not a v-version
тег из одной v            | push | tag    | v             |       | | !error:not a v-version

тег latest                | push | tag    | latest        |       | | !error:not a v-version
